Require ADX > 25 as confirmation for long trades; weak trend environments (ADX <25) show poor win rates.

patterns.recommendation: Strongest short setup: negative MACD combined with DI- >40 shows dominant edge; prioritize these high-conviction shorts.

strongest_long_setup: RSI 55-65, DI+ > DI- by 15+ points, ADX >25, positive or neutral MACD, SENTIMENT > -0.15. Avoid when sentiment is negative.
strongest_short_setup: RSI 37-45, DI- > DI+ by 10+ points, MACD negative, ADX >25, SENTIMENT < +0.50. MACD + strong DI- dominance (>40) shows 80% win rate on shorts.
summary: Your win rate of 45% masks a clear pattern: SHORT setups with negative MACD and DI- >40 win 80% of the time (10/10 trades), while LONG entries with high RSI (>60) combined with negative sentiment lose 83% (1/6 trades). The DNE miss rate of 30% is acceptable given the low overall win rate—focus first on filtering trades by the strong-edge conditions identified rather than generating more signals. Implement strict RSI range requirements (55-65 for LONG, 37-45 for SHORT) and avoid high-sentiment contradictions to improve from 45% to 60%+.
